system.description: Use an action and spend up to 30 MP, choosing one creature you can see per 5 MP spent, up to six. Each recovers from all status effects and is no longer affected by any spell with a duration of Scene. Six-target full cleanse for 30 MP — and it strips the party's own Scene-duration buffs too. The single best answer on the roster to the Apothecary's multi-type Affliction.
